simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֵמְתָּנִי (H574) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֵמְתָּנִי (ʼêmᵉtânîy) means well-loined (i.e. burly) or mighty First listed occurrence: Dan 7 7.

definitions.full: H574. emthan [ אֵימְתָן D § 35, 1 θ ] adjective terrible ( אֵימְתָן ᵑ7 , from אֵימְתָא = Biblical Hebrew אֵימָה , q. v. v אים ); — feminine singular absolute אֵימְתָנִי (K § 61, 5 )) Dan 7:7 (on form see Prät ZMG lvi (1902), 156 Nö BSSW 51, Anm. 3 ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of 4975 ;
